releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web update 324: In Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder, the Custom weekday picker stays open while selecting or deselecting days, so multiple weekdays can be chosen in one visit. The × button closes it; the Custom din badlein control reopens it with previous selections preserved.
